test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Aluna Kabuini is associated with which of the following dances?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipuri.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Aluna Kabuini was born in the year 1946 at Keishamthong Kabui Khun
 
• Aluna Kabuini love to dance in different styles and depict the rich heritage of **Kabui and manipuri Dance** 
 
• She also acted as the main role in a Kabui Naga Dance and Drama Centre’s drama show - **“Yathang”**
 
• She received the **Manipur State Kala Akademi Award for Tribal Kabui Dance in 2001-2002.**
 
• Aluna Kabuini also wrote and published a book titled as **“Kabui Theory and Songs”**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Classical dances recognised by the Sangeet Natak Akademi and the Ministry of Culture
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam, from Tamil Nadu**
 
• **Kathak, from Uttar Pradesh**
 
• **Kathakali, from Kerala**
 
• **Kuchipudi, from Andhra Pradesh**
 
• **Manipuri, from Manipur**
 
• **Mohiniyattam, from Kerala**
 
• **Odissi, from Odisha**
 
• **Sattriya, from Assam**
 
 
 
• Additionally, the Indian Ministry of Culture includes **Chhau, from Eastern India (Odisha, Jharkhand, and West Bengal) **in its list, recognising nine total styles
